goal: Trace independent evaluator failures into exact ProviderJob repair and select generation and repair models by measured capability.
acceptance_criteria: Every observed evaluator failure is traceable through issue, ProviderJob, Provider call, delta, and acceptance or has an explicit missing-boundary reason.
Unmatched product failures create repair issues only for one or two exact existing ProviderJob-owned files.
Generation and repair model selection use bounded capability scores rather than availability alone.
Fresh CASE01 and CASE03 preserve one Provider scheduler, frozen benchmark hashes, and unchanged final gates.

quality_metrics.measure: mapped failures, created jobs, returned deltas, accepted deltas, and fixed failures
quality_metrics.target: no silent failure-to-repair drop and zero generic component expansion
quality_metrics.method: failure-to-repair audit, focused contract tests, and fresh independent CASE01/CASE03 evaluation

prevention: Keep evaluator mapping deterministic, path-bounded, and separate from Provider scheduling.
assurance: Compare score-33, score-23, and fresh candidates before changing production behavior.
control: Run environment, rule, kernel, focused pytest, py_compile, and frozen hash checks.
improvement: Use one cheap structured manifest-plus-patch probe to select models by task fitness.

interface_expectations: The existing production split-file leaf executor remains the only ProviderJob execution path.
The read-only audit cannot mutate candidate, evidence, package, or delivery state.
External evaluator evidence without exact ownership remains non-repairable.

feedback: Deterministic mapping, capability-based selection, one-scheduler ownership, and failure-to-repair observability passed focused regression.
Fresh CASE01 and CASE03 remained PROJECT_FAIL at score 5, so product convergence is not accepted as complete.

worked: Capability probing found four usable models and selected separate generation and repair roles without adding an execution path.
CASE01 reached bounded post-build repair and accepted one exact DOM-coherence improvement without a new blocker.
did_not_work: CASE01 business repairs failed affected-behavior validation after the accepted DOM delta.
CASE03 test generation imported Selenium and exhausted leaf repair before candidate materialization, so post-build repair could not start.
experiments: Next increment should make the existing semantic-review repair handoff correct the exact forbidden test dependency before candidate materialization; no new scheduler or retry layer.
